start.greeting: Welcome. You can fill in the guest register before you arrive.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
common.rateLimited: Too many tries. Please wait a minute and try again.

lang.hint: About 3 min · Have your passport ready

find.title: Let's find your booking
find.body: Enter the name you booked with, your check-in date and your booking number.
find.referenceHelp: Airbnb numbers start with HM; Booking.com numbers have 10 digits. You'll find it in the booking app or confirmation email.
find.noReference: No booking number · Find with the last 4 digits of your phone
find.phoneBody: The last 4 digits of the phone number you gave when booking.
find.phoneHelp: If you didn't give a phone number either, check in on the tablet inside the building when you arrive.

notFound.title: We couldn't find your booking
notFound.body: Something you entered doesn't match the booking. Please check it again.
notFound.tip1: Use the spelling you booked with. It may differ from your passport.
notFound.tip2: The check-in date is the day you arrive.
notFound.tip3: If you just booked, try again in about 5 minutes.
notFound.remaining: 5 wrong tries locks this for 10 minutes · {n} so far
notFound.pageBody: Please open the link from your booking message again.

locked.title: Paused for a moment
locked.body: Several tries didn't match, so finding is paused for a while. This keeps others from peeking at bookings.
locked.arrived: If you're already at the building, don't wait — check in on the tablet inside.
locked.staff: If you can't wait, message our staff through your booking, or tap “Call staff” on the tablet inside the building.

guests.title: {name}'s booking
guests.companionHint: Just a passport photo and 5 fields
guests.childHint: Children can go without a passport
guests.share: You can fill in one person at a time. You can also send this page's link to the others so each fills in their own.
guests.removeSeatConfirm: Fewer guests than booked? We'll remove one empty spot from the list.

person.photoHelp: Look at the photo and enter everything exactly as on the passport
person.takePhoto: Take or choose a passport photo
person.photoError: We couldn't upload the photo. Please choose an image file (up to 10 MB).
person.japanAddress: I have an address in Japan
person.contactHelp: Phone or email — one is enough
person.retention: Kept as the guest register for 3 years, then deleted
person.invalid: Please check the fields marked in red
person.locked: Check-in is finished, so this can't be changed anymore
person.notComingConfirm: Remove this guest from the list? What you entered and the passport photo will be deleted.

route.title: Where are you coming from, and where to next?
route.sub: We have to record this in the guest register. A city name is enough.
route.prevQ: ① Where did you stay last night?
route.prevHint: The place you stayed right before this one
route.prevBorderHint: I came straight from the airport or port
route.nextQ: ② Where are you going next?
route.nextHint: Where you head after checking out
route.nextBorderHint: Heading to the airport or port
route.note: Your group gets the same answers. Each person can change theirs.

address.title: Where do you live?
address.sub: The guest register needs each guest's full home address.
address.label: Home address
address.placeholder: e.g. USA, Boston, 12 Main St, Apt 4
address.question: Do all {n} guests live at this address?
address.diffTitle: Tap the people who live elsewhere
address.diffSub: Only the people you tap get their own address. Everyone else is the same as {name}.
address.errShort: Please write the full address: country, city, building and room
address.errLatin: Please write in English letters. Korean, Japanese and Chinese characters can't be used
address.errPick: Enter a different address, or untap this person
address.locked: Check-in is done, so this can't be changed
address.error: We couldn't save. Please try again in a moment.

terms.title: Please agree
terms.line1: We keep a guest register as required by Japan's Hotel Business Act.
terms.line2: The register and passport photos are kept for 3 years, then deleted.
terms.line3: They are used only for the guest register and never given to others.
terms.terms: I agree to the terms of stay
terms.minors: A parent or guardian agrees for any minors in the group
terms.countDiffers: Booked for {booked}, {n} on the list. Our staff will check.

done.body: Everyone ({n}) is entered. It takes 1 minute when you arrive.
done.step1: Enter the code on the tablet at the entrance
done.step2: Each person records a 5-second face video
done.step3: Your room number and door code appear

readonly.title: Check-in is complete
readonly.body: Finished on the tablet at {when}. Enjoy your stay.
readonly.note: Check-in is finished, so the register can't be changed. Tell the staff if anything needs fixing.
